answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure gateway, verified by a rhythm-based audit of heartbeat pulses that act like an ivory tower to confirm exclusive occupancy. An honest agent pays for its unique reservation, while 1,000 fakes must incur immense costs to maintain concurrent slots, appearing as a chaotic nebula of requests. A verifier checks the zenith of the stream to ensure no overlap occurs, and any lapse triggers an immediate, irreversible privilege revocation; refunding is prohibited.
